Research

What I Study

AI · Education

Artificial Intelligence in Education

Investigating how AI systems can be designed to meaningfully support learners and educators in real educational contexts.

Human-AI

Human-AI Collaboration

Studying the synergy between human cognition and AI assistance — how people and intelligent systems can learn together effectively.

Analytics

Multimodal Learning Analytics

Analysing physiological signals (EDA, eye-tracking), audio, and interaction data to understand and predict learner engagement.

Inclusion

Inclusive Technology

Designing educational tech for everyone — including research on closed captioning and accessibility for DHH students.

CT Skills

Computational Thinking

Fostering computational thinking skills in middle school students through innovative mobile applications and pedagogy.

GenAI

Prompt Engineering & GenAI

Evaluating the effectiveness of training students in prompt engineering for generative AI chatbots in education.

ET 606

Tools Lab

July – December 2025 · IIT Bombay
Instructor Prof. Sridhar Iyer
Co-Instructor Sonika Pal
TA Anupam Kolay

Explored GenAI tools alongside other widely-used tools for educational teaching and learning, helping students critically evaluate and apply them in real educational contexts. At the end of the course, students analysed each tool's pros and cons for education — covering tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Canva AI, NotebookLM, Gamma, Mentimeter and more.
